rationale.A: ~1.1 km in mixed traffic on Ilkantie and Nuijamiestentie (40 km/h), 4 unsignalised crossings
rationale.B: Central Park approach without mixed traffic, but ~1 km on the Nuijamiestentie-side track and several unsignalised crossings
rationale.C: Straight through Central Park (Keskuspuistontaival); only ~1.2 km roadside, 1 unsignalised crossing, 1 light; +1 min
rationale.D: Via Isonneva and Tilkka; 80 m in traffic, ~2.8 km roadside, 5 unsignalised crossings; +4 min
rationale.E: Central Park via Pirkkola; nearly as calm as C but +4 min
rationale.F: Rail-side path (Rantaradan varsiraitti) with long roadside stretches along Näyttelijäntie, Veturitie and Ratapihantie; +6 min
rationale.G: Central Park then Käpylä and a track beside Ratapihantie; ~3 km roadside; +7 min
rationale.H: Pitäjänmäki and Tilkka paths; ~1.2 km beside Pitäjänmäentie; +8 min

notes: Clear case: C is calmest, has fewest lights (1 vs 3) and costs only +1 min.
